source: Condensed from the BA Circulation Policy public page; internal automation only.

policies.message: Only researchers can benefit from the circulation service in the Main Reading Area.
Borrowing requires an individual membership card.
You already have the maximum number of books allowed on loan. Return one before borrowing more.
Two books can be borrowed at a time. Requests for more than two books cannot be approved.
Books can be borrowed for up to two weeks (14 days). Requests exceeding this period are rejected.
This material type is not available for circulation.

policies.condition: request_type == 'borrow' and user_type == 'researcher' and has_membership_card == true and books_requested <= 2 and days_requested <= 14
policies.message: Borrowing request meets all circulation criteria: researcher, valid membership, within book limit, within loan period, and regular circulating material.
This category is not available for borrowing: references, periodicals, audio-visual materials, predominantly illustrated monographs, theses, and closed stacks books must be used in-house.
Renewals must be handled through the Circulation Desk, the Library website, or by calling +(203) 4839999 Ext: 1568.
Reservations for books currently borrowed by another member must be placed through the Circulation Desk. You will be notified when the book becomes available.
Lost book reports must be handled at the Circulation Desk. If confirmed missing after a month, the full value of the book plus administrative fees may apply.
Damaged books must be reported immediately. Do not attempt to repair the damage. Qualified Library specialists will examine the book.
Members must pay outstanding fines before borrowing other books.
Membership is suspended until the overdue book is delivered back and the fine is fully paid.
